current.text: He is a rookie. The Bucks drafted him 13th overall in 2026.
He had a bad summer league: about 10 points and 5 rebounds per game, only 0.4 blocks, and he missed his free throws.
He had a back injury over the summer.
He is not among the projected Bucks starters. The projected starters are Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Ware and Turner.
His path to NBA minutes looks weak right now.
Experts rank him below his draft slot. Several think he was not worth the 13th pick and that he might just be a bad player.

durable.text: Experts say his shooting and efficiency numbers are horrific and doubt his shooting and scoring.
Before the NBA he scored in high volume and rebounded well.
He has size, an interesting frame and scoring upside.
He might be an okay defender, but experts want more blocks from him than he has shown.

note: Both sites price him at 0 USD and rank him 689 (Yahoo) and 294 (ESPN). That is far outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not draft him. His projected line is weak: 8 points on 42.6% FG and no category with a real edge (blocks are only about average). Early in the season, check whether Taylor Jenkins gives him minutes at power forward, which a team note calls Milwaukee's weakest position. If he gets those minutes, keep an eye on him as a waiver option.
